data.one_liner: Read referrer information for incoming deep links on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that allows you to read various referrer information when the app is opened via a deep link. It uses native APIs like NSUserActivity#referrerUrl on iOS and Intent.EXTRA_REFERRER on Android. On unsupported platforms, calls result in a no-op.
use_when: You need to know the webpage or application URL that caused your app to open via a deep link
You are handling deep links with Flutter's mechanism or packages like app_links and need referrer details
avoid_when: You need to track app install referrers rather than deep link referrers
You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS
strengths: Simple API to fetch referrer information
Works well with existing deep-linking solutions and routing libraries
weaknesses: Referrer information is subject to platform limitations and browser referrer policies
May not be available for certain browsers like Firefox or depending on user intent
Does not support install referrer tracking
data.setup_notes: No complex configuration required. Platforms other than Android and iOS are treated as no-ops.
